svg.title: Data flow and trust boundaries
svg.text: F8 sentences, questions, photos, face video, “Yes”
* Only if the language model is not hosted by Altice. Blue: flows that cross a trust boundary, described in the table.

The changed region (at most 640 × 640, about 1 a second during motion) or the one asked for in a check; rarely, 2 to 3 s of the region for the judge; the face labels (“Filipe”, “unknown face”) with their
boxes. Never continuous video or face templates
Active-check and refresh requests; the face video when a person is registered, relayed without being stored; masks; orders to delete templates
Which Family phones are on the Wi-Fi, and when they join or leave (proposed MCP tool)
Door open or closed, as today
Commands after a “Yes”: light, plug, siren
Text only: the sentence or question, the names of things, places and devices, memory lines. The judge’s clips stay at Altice
TLS; a contract with no training on the data, a DPA and EU
The structured rule, the answer or the verdict
Sentences, questions, photos of things, the face video, “Yes”
HTTPS, with the Altice app’s session
Alerts: title, message, action cards, link to the thumbnail
Answers and thumbnails, through short-lived signed links
Never cross the home boundary: continuous video and face templates. Method: a data-flow diagram with trust boundaries, as in the Microsoft SDL and OWASP threat modelling.
